quote: Document every exported function in Visual Studio Code and add each one to the API index, with a thousand agents.

say: Talk opens the Runs page and fills in the job: the copy of VS Code, the folder, doc comments plus a line in the API index, a thousand agents, a five-dollar cap, and the estimate.
A thousand agents start. Each writes its comments and one line in a shared index file, so they collide all the time, and each collision is redone on the newest code.

cap: At 1:53 the run paused itself: model errors passed its 5% safety stop. It was resumed by hand.

say: Then it finished: 2,833 files landed for two dollars and thirty-three cents. A checker read main: every function in the index once, sorted, nothing lost.

cap: 2,833 landed, 1,069 already documented, 162 rejected. Index check: 5,917 entries, 0 missing, 0 twice.
